Ṛcaka
Kāṭhaka mantras; Kashmirian, used in Karmakāṇḍa.
-30. D. p. 73 (2 mss.). Damodar. IIO. Stein 243. 287. Imperial Library, Vienna. Oudh
(4 mss.). PUL. I. p. 131 (2 mss.). Report I. Weber 1507. 1771 (with C.). See also

; there is a ms. of it in D. A. V. College, Lahore, no. 6171 used by Suryakanta in his Kāṭhakasaṅkalana, Meharchand Lachmandas, Lahore, 1943. See ib. Intro. l-liii an. Foreword to the edn. of the Kāṭhaka by L. [Page028-b] von Schroeder, Leipzig, 1900. See also under Karmakāṇḍa an. Kāṭhaka.
